title: Review soft flashlight falloff changes
objective: Review Builder's soft co-located flashlight falloff changes for correctness, robustness, and workflow fit before we treat them as ready.
instructions: Focus on the current uncommitted changes in examples/flashlight/run.py, examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh, examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json, docs/running_our_example_applications.md, and tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py.

Assess whether the defaults and new source-radius/soft-source-radius controls are likely to soften the hard circular spotlight edge in the scene_off_flashlight_on render while preserving scene_off_flashlight_off darkness and the existing intensity/direction/scene-light/exposure controls.
Check for API robustness against SPEAR/Unreal proxy limitations, argument validation errors, test adequacy, docs drift, and any regression risk in live teleop and render modes.
constraints: Do not edit product code unless a small test-only or review-support change is absolutely necessary; this is primarily review/QA.
expected_outputs: Findings first, with file/line references for any issues.
Recommendation: ready, needs Builder follow-up, or needs visual validation.
definition_of_done: Review result packet clearly identifies blockers or says no blockers found.
Any suggested follow-up is concrete and scoped.
